what do we have now?

We have a **draft** for Facebook and TikTok:

- **Facebook:** a fantasy-themed caption about classic Pokémon GBA games, plus an image.
- **TikTok:** a short caption: “Classic Pokémon GBA feels like a spellbook—follow DucoThePaladin’s quest ⚔️✨”
- **Video:** a cinematic video was generated for the draft.

It hasn’t been published.
why my video is only 5 second?
The workflow is configured for **10 seconds**, so the 5-second clip was shorter than intended. I can’t see why the video generator returned a shorter clip from the available details.
can you update the video duration to 20s?
Updated the TikTok Cinematic video step to **20 seconds**. This applies to future workflow runs; it doesn’t change the video on the existing draft.
can you rerun the current video with 20 second duration?
The current-video generator supports up to 15 seconds. Generate a new 15-second TikTok cinematic video instead?
User choice: yes (Yes, generate 15 seconds)

I couldn’t generate the 15-second video because cinematic-avatar mode needs an avatar look selected first. Pick or upload one in the TikTok Cinematic video step on the workflow canvas, then I can try again.
use one from my brand

finish?

The run is marked complete, but the **new 15-second video isn’t confirmed**. The workflow still shows its TikTok Cinematic video step as skipped because it required a HeyGen look. I can’t verify that the new scene video was added.
